summary: A flat paragraph For every loop without an inline body or indented block is rejected, not silently dropped.
A phrase expression used directly as the argument of another phrase (Say count of ...) is not recursively phrase-resolved; bind it to a Let first.
Very long fixed English sentences do not panic Link Grammar; they fall back to a clean Unsupported verdict.
The TUI/GUI parity runner has a 10,000,000-step reference-interpreter budget; the CLI uses 50,000,000. Programs exceeding it return a structured result, not a panic.
StrMap stores TcString pointers supplied by the caller; keys must stay alive until the map is freed. IntMap and StrMap now grow beyond 256 entries.
